title: Velocity Conversion
text: Convert from velocity units to desired velocity units, 1 input, 1 output, {Initial unit} sets Input units; {Final unit} sets the output units. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial unit
params.values: Input units ft/s (default) | m/s | km/s | in/s | km/h | mph | kts | ft/min

params.name: Final unit
params.values: Output units m/s (default) | ft/s | km/s | in/s | km/h | mph | kts | ft/min
